svg.title: Behind the viral '9x pancreatitis' number: the case counts
svg.desc: Behind the viral '9x pancreatitis' number: the case counts. Pancreatitis: semaglutide 4.6 (2 cases), liraglutide 7.9 (71 cases), bupropion-naltrexone 1.0 (1 cases). Bowel obstruction: semaglutide 0 (0 cases), liraglutide 8.1 (73 cases), bupropion-naltrexone 1.7 (2 cases). Gastroparesis: semaglutide 9.1 (4 cases), liraglutide 7.3 (66 cases), bupropion-naltrexone 3.1 (3 cases).

text.font-family: Inter, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
